faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Use Request a quote, tell us what you want covered, and a consultant sends a quotation, usually within one working day.

faq.q: How do I pay my premium?
faq.a: By direct debit from your CBZ account or by mobile money. You choose when you apply.
Use Submit a claim with your policy number and what happened. A claims assessor contacts you about the next steps and any documents.

faq.q: Can I insure something CBZ Bank is financing?
faq.a: Yes. Cover can be arranged alongside a CBZ Bank facility, so the asset is protected from the day it is financed.
